rows.body: Curio Collection by Hilton (upper-upscale soft collection, Hilton) economics below reflect typical disclosed ranges from the franchise disclosure document—not a quote or substitute for your countersigned agreement, LOI, or advisors.

Monthly royalty (5% monthly royalty on gross rooms revenue (GRR))
Monthly program fee (4% monthly program fee on GRR)
Program fee may ramp (3% yrs 1–2, 3.50% yr 3, 4% steady-state)—not guaranteed.
Hilton Honors (4% Hilton Honors on eligible guest folio (waived for on-property enrollment stays))
Digital direct marketing (1.35% of digital direct revenue, capped per stay)
Third-party reservation charges (up to $6.05/stay)
OnQ stack (initial $82,800–$218,800; maintenance $2,295–$6,689/mo)
Initial term length by deal type (new build vs conversion vs change of ownership)
PIP at opening, conversion, re-licensing, and cycled renovation

Owner typically funds: Conversion or new-build PIP, FF&E, OnQ and connected-room cutover ($82,800–$218,800 illustrative), working capital, and franchise application/training cash outlays.

Brand typically provides: Design review, opening playbooks, pre-opening support ($20,000 opening process services fee), and milestone QA—not operating payroll.

Owner typically funds: Ramp marketing and Hilton Honors enrollment while occupancy builds; monthly royalty and program fees scale with gross rooms revenue.

Brand typically provides: Negotiated program-fee ramp (3% early years when offered), royalty relief in competitive deals, and channel guidance—not guaranteed.

Owner funds: Steady-state fee stack—5% royalty + 4% program fee on GRR, plus Hilton Honors, OnQ maintenance, and distribution charges.

Brand provides: Hilton distribution, QA cadence, and benchmarks—not property payroll or routine FF&E.

Owner typically funds: Re-licensing application, renewal or conversion PIP, reserves, and potential new franchise agreement terms—there is no automatic renewal right.

Brand typically provides: Re-licensing standards; phased PIP timing may be negotiable when re-licensing is offered in Hilton's discretion.

rows.title: Application & Feasibility
rows.body: Submit franchise application ($85,000 new-build/conversion (+ $400/key over 250)); pay PIP fee ($10,000 when applicable). Qualify conversion, new-build, or change-of-ownership path—market tier, F&B scope, and experiential PIP before term sheet.

rows.title: Design & Standards
rows.body: Curio design narrative and culinary-forward F&B plan—adaptive reuse, destination character, and Hilton design approval before major FF&E commit.

rows.title: Pre-Opening Planning
rows.body: PIP sequencing, OS&E, OnQ PMS/CRS cutover ($82,800–$218,800), required training ($5,000–$15,000), and F&B onboarding.

rows.title: Opening Support
rows.body: Hilton opening training, Curio service execution, design and F&B QA, soft opening, and Hilton Honors launch—budget opening process services ($20,000).

rows.title: Stabilization
rows.body: Heightened QA on design, culinary execution, and guest experience during ramp; third-party operators run day-to-day while Hilton development tracks milestone remediation.

Typical Curio path: application and PIP scoping → design and F&B narrative approval → OnQ and Hilton systems cutover → opening QA on experiential standards → stabilization. Third-party management is common; Hilton approves brand milestones while the operator runs opening.

Illustrative 200-room total investment $3.9M–$119.6M ($19,642–$597,790/key (200-room illustrative, ex-land), excluding real property). Amounts paid to Hilton/affiliates before opening up to $467,680 in the same illustration.

rows.title: To Join
rows.body: Application $85,000 new-build/conversion (+ $400/key over 250); Change of ownership $150,000; PIP fee $10,000; Opening process services $20,000; OnQ hardware/software/install $82,800–$218,800; Required training $5,000–$15,000; Design, market study, and F&B concept costs vary by conversion vs new-build

rows.title: To Operate
rows.body: Steady-state 5% monthly royalty on gross rooms revenue (GRR); 4% monthly program fee on GRR; 4% Hilton Honors on eligible guest folio (waived for on-property enrollment stays); Hilton Advance 1.35% digital direct (max $30/stay); OnQ maintenance $2,295–$6,689/month; Eforea spa royalty 2% gross spa revenue (if spa amendment); Model net contribution after loyalty chargebacks and distribution—not headline RevPAR

rows.title: When Things Change
rows.body: Re-licensing (no auto-renewal), conversion PIP, room-addition fees ($400/key), termination liquidated damages, and reserves—triggered at exit, flag change, or ownership transfer.
Room count, market tier, new build vs conversion vs change of ownership, incentive package, spa/restaurant brand amendments, and operator-led opening change how fees and capital land on your deal.

rows.title: Term & renewal
rows.body: 23 yr new build · 10–20 yr conversion · no automatic renewal. Re-licensing may require materially different terms than the original franchise agreement.

rows.title: Performance & exit
rows.body: QA evaluations, brand non-compliance fees, service improvement programs, and cure paths—understand liquidated damages on early termination with counsel.

rows.title: Transfer & sale
rows.body: Change-of-ownership application ($150,000 in disclosure table), brand approval, and potential re-licensing terms affect liquidity—plan before marketing the asset.

rows.title: Area of protection
rows.body: Area-of-protection limits same-brand competition—confirm geography in franchise agreement and state addenda.

rows.title: Royalty / brand fee
rows.body: 5% monthly royalty on gross rooms revenue (GRR)—upper-upscale soft collection standards, QA, and Hilton portfolio access. Optional Eforea spa: +2% gross spa revenue.

rows.title: Marketing / brand fund
rows.body: 4% monthly program fee on GRR funds system and network programs (not a segregated advertising fund). Program fee may ramp (3% yrs 1–2, 3.50% yr 3, 4% steady-state)—not guaranteed. Rate capped at current plus 1% of GRR over franchise term.

rows.title: Technology / systems
rows.body: OnQ initial $82,800–$218,800; connectivity $400–$600/mo; maintenance $2,295–$6,689/mo—plus connected room, GRO, and digital key stack per HITS agreement.

rows.title: Loyalty / program participation
rows.body: 4% Hilton Honors on eligible guest folio (waived for on-property enrollment stays). Model net contribution after member benefits, reward redemptions, and guest assistance handling fees.

rows.title: Reservation / distribution
rows.body: Hilton Advance 1.35% on digital direct revenue (max $30/stay); third-party reservation charges up to $6.05/stay. Stress-test OTA vs Hilton direct mix. Item 19 sample (2025): ~75% avg Hilton Honors occupancy contribution (63 comparable U.S. hotels).
